# 🔍 SEO Optimizer · www.example.com
**50/100** 🟠 · Crawlable homepage, but the pricing page is hidden from search and one page is empty without JavaScript.

## ⚡ This week's changes
| # | Page | Change | Impact | Effort | Owner |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | /app | Server-render the app page so crawlers can read it | 🔴 high | project | Eng |
| 2 | /pricing | Remove noindex and write a descriptive title | 🔴 high | quick fix | Web |
| 3 | / | Shorten the title and add a meta description | 🔴 high | quick fix | Web |

## 📊 Scorecard
Indexability | ░░░░░░░░░░ 0/10
Titles & meta descriptions | ██░░░░░░░░ 2/10
Headings & content | ██░░░░░░░░ 2/10
Structured data & social | ███████░░░ 7/10
Internal links & images | ████████░░ 8/10
Technical | ████████░░ 8/10

## 🧰 Copy-ready fixes
### 1. /app — Server-render the app page so crawlers can read it
The page has 0 words in its raw HTML; most crawlers other than Google see it empty.

### 2. /pricing — Remove noindex and write a descriptive title
The page is in the sitemap but says "noindex", and its 7-character title "Pricing" does not say what is priced.
```
robots meta: noindex → remove
title (7 → 57): Invoice Software Pricing for Agencies — Example Invoicing
description (85 → 129): Plans for agencies of every size, from one person to fifty, billed monthly or yearly. See what each plan includes and pick yours.
```

### 3. / — Shorten the title and add a meta description
The homepage title is 83 characters, so search results cut it off, and the page has no meta description.
```
title (83 → 49): Invoice Software for Agencies — Example Invoicing
description (0 → 129): Invoices for agencies that bill by the hour and by the project. Send them, track them and get paid faster with Example Invoicing.
```

## ❔ What this brief could not check
- Pages were read as raw HTML without running JavaScript.
- Rankings, clicks and search volume need Search Console or an SEO data provider.

Every change is a draft: check the facts before you publish.
